title: Storage
description: A batch or unit enters or leaves a temperature-mapped, qualified storage facility (EU GDP; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9 Supplement 8). Unlike transport, location is a single place, not an origin and a destination - conditions is asserted by the facility operator, once per stay (spec Sec.7.2).

conditions.description: Storage conditions promised for this stay. Whether they were kept is what measurement entries taken during the stay say - not this field (spec Sec.7.2, Sec.7.3).
